name: Do garage tile floors require a specific type of grout?

mainEntity.name: Do garage tile floors require a specific type of grout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Epoxy grout is strongly recommended for garage installations instead of standard cement-based grout. While standard grout is porous and absorbs motor oil, anti-freeze, brake fluid, and dirty melting slush, epoxy grout cures into an impermeable, plastic-like barrier. The practical tradeoff is that epoxy grout sets quickly and requires meticulous cleanup during installation to avoid a hazy residue on the tile surface. However, the result is completely stain-proof grout lines that can be washed with standard degreasers without degrading or discoloring.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, epoxy grout is ideal because it is completely waterproof, chemical-resistant, and will not absorb motor oil or dirty melted snow like standard grout.
